nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: XC6206 LDO regulator steps VIN_5V down to VCC_3V3. VIN pin connected to VIN_5V rail, VOUT is system power VCC_3V3. VSS pin connected to GND. This module is the sole source of the VCC_3V3 rail for downstream modules.

nodes.name: usb_to_uart
nodes.description: CH340 USB-to-UART bridge. USB differential lines UD_P and UD_N connect to USB port (outside this module). TXD outputs UART data to MCU, RXD receives data from MCU. VCC pin is USB 5V supply; V3 pin needs 3.3V reference for internal regulator. XI and XI pins for crystal (not provided in component list, intent to add 12MHz crystal). CTS, DSR, RI, DCD, DTR, RTS, R232 pins are modem control signals; brief does not specify usage, so they are left as NC/DNC.

nodes.name: GND
nodes.description: Ground. Connect to USB bus ground.

nodes.name: TXD
nodes.description: Serial data output to MCU RXD.

nodes.name: RXD
nodes.description: Serial data input from MCU TXD.

nodes.name: V3
nodes.description: Internal 3.3V regulator output. At 5V: connect 0.1uF cap to GND. At 3.3V: connect to VCC.

nodes.name: UD_P
nodes.description: USB D+ data line. Connect directly to USB connector.

nodes.name: UD_N
nodes.description: USB D- data line. Connect directly to USB connector.

nodes.name: CTS
nodes.description: MODEM Clear To Send, active low. Leave unconnected if unused.

nodes.name: DSR
nodes.description: MODEM Data Set Ready, active low. Leave unconnected if unused.

nodes.name: RI
nodes.description: MODEM Ring Indicator, active low. Leave unconnected if unused.

nodes.name: DCD
nodes.description: MODEM Data Carrier Detect, active low. Leave unconnected if unused.

nodes.name: DTR
nodes.description: MODEM Data Terminal Ready, active low. Often used for MCU auto-reset.

nodes.name: RTS
nodes.description: MODEM Request To Send, active low. Often used for MCU boot mode.

nodes.name: R232
nodes.description: RS232 enable, active high. Built-in pull-down. Leave floating for TTL mode.

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: CH32V003 RISC-V MCU. VDD pin powered by VCC_3V3. VSS pin connected to GND. Program/communication via UART using RX (RXD) and TX (TXD) pins; brief does not specify specific pins, need to select from GPIO (PD0/PD1/...). I2C interface for AT24C256 EEPROM, need to select SDA/SCL pins from GPIO (PC4/PC5/...). All other GPIO pins are general purpose. BOOT mode not specified in pin list.

nodes.name: PD7
nodes.description: GPIO, alt: NRST (active low reset). Must have pull-up or reset circuit.

nodes.name: PD1
nodes.description: GPIO, alt: SWIO (single-wire debug)/T1CH3N. Default debug pin.

nodes.name: eeprom
nodes.description: AT24C256 256Kbit I2C EEPROM. Powered by VCC_3V3. SDA and SCL lines connect to MCU's I2C bus. Address pins A0/A1/A2 not listed in component data; assume they are tied to GND or VCC via pull-ups/downs for address 0x00.

nodes.name: A0
nodes.description: Address bit 0. Tie to GND or VCC. I2C address = 1010_A2_A1_A0.

nodes.name: A1
nodes.description: Address bit 1. Tie to GND or VCC.

nodes.name: A2
nodes.description: Address bit 2. Tie to GND or VCC. Up to 8 devices on one bus.

nodes.name: SDA
nodes.description: I2C data, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: WP
nodes.description: Write Protect. GND=write enabled, VCC=write inhibited.
